component.name: Mailbox
component.summary: A self-contained IMAP and SMTP client

description.p: One mail client with many faces: this window, a terminal interface, a command line and a local web page, all over the same offline store.

ul.li: A single search field that takes the same query language as the command line
Keyboard triage: archive, delete, snooze and flag without leaving the list
Messages render as sanitized HTML with remote images off until you allow them
Works offline, and sends from an outbox that survives a crash
Updates itself from inside the window

description.p: Adds macOS packaging, hosted deployment, and mailbox usability improvements.
